newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ascom sees higher 1996 operating result.
newsitem.headline: Ascom sees higher 1996 operating result.

text.p: Ascom Holding AG said it expects its operating profit in 1996 to exceed last year's result, assuming that markets remain stable.
"Given unchanged market conditions, Ascom expects to close fiscal 1996 with an improved operating result," Ascom said in a statement issued at a news conference.

Ascom also said that it expected a continuation of the positive trend in its Telecommuncations segment in the second half of the year and further improvement in the results at its Service Automation segement.
Business at Ascom Timeplex should also stabilise following the recent restructuring while the search for cooperation partners continue.
Ascom reported an operating profit of 39 million Swiss francs in the first half of 1996, up 39 percent from 28 million in the 1995 first half.
In 1995 Ascom reported an operating profit of 75 million and a net profit of 25 million.
In its previous forecast for 1996, Ascom had only said that it was "cautiously optimistic" for the year.
